title: BROKEN MIND
description:
BROKEN MIND is an action Survival Horror. Investigate, solve the puzzles and find out what happened to Laura Campbell. If she is still alive you must act quickly!WHAT HAPPENED TO LAURA CAMPBELL?
In BROKEN MIND, you play Agent Frank Morgan, a detective with a dark past. You will have to investigate the disappearance of a teenage girl who was abducted during a live Internet broadcast. The investigation is accelerated when Laura's phone emits a signal a few miles away in the middle of the forest!FIGHT FOR YOUR LIFE
BROKEN MIND is a narrative game that requires you to fight. In the course of your investigation, you'll encounter numerous enemies who will try to stand in your way.

SOLVE PUZZLES
During your investigation, you'll come across a number of puzzles that you'll need to solve. Keep a close eye on your surroundings for clues.

YOU'LL HAVE TO BE DISCRET
Sometimes fighting isn't an option, so you'll have to hide to avoid being caught by your assailants.

UNIQUE HAND MADE DRAWINGS
Discover a dark, oppressive atmosphere with graphics that blend 3D scenery and hand-drawn images.

FEATURES
- A narrative game with gameplay that mixes investigations, puzzles and combat!
- Follow the story from different angles, playing several characters with unique skills.
- Fully voice acted game thanks to 7 actors.
- An oppressive atmosphere, with a graphic style mixing 3D and hand made drawings
- The biggest project of the studio !
description_short: BROKEN MIND is an action Survival Horror. Investigate, solve the puzzles and find out what happened to Laura Campbell. If she is still alive you must act quickly!
